dedupe_keys.name: dream ukraine s digital restoration ecosystem reconstruction project data and open data api

description: DREAM is Ukraine's state digital ecosystem for managing reconstruction, built so that every recovery project can be followed from planning to commissioning in public. The ministry news item read on 2026-09-28 reports the presentation of a pilot public application programming interface that opens the data of all projects entered in DREAM to professional users with analytics tools, at a time when more than 1,700 projects were registered, and announces an analytics module on the public portal with tables and charts and later risk management tools to find bottlenecks and prevent violations; officials of the ministry and the State Agency for Restoration stressed transparency as a condition for financing. Coverage is national, for reconstruction projects of communities and state bodies (roads, bridges, housing, schools, hospitals, energy and water). Access is free through the portal and API; no licence is named in the news. Caveats: the API refused the cloud session in round 1 (HTTP 451), project counts have grown since the news, and data quality depends on what agencies enter. It supports resilience and recovery studies of war-damaged Ukrainian infrastructure, such as reconstruction pipelines and costs by sector. No related Ukrainian reconstruction record is catalogued; damage assessments complement it.
